title: 7.7 Would you like to come to my party?
unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
lesson_title: Would you like to come to my party?
sub_lesson_title: Would you like to come to my party?
goal: Invite someone with Would you like to …? and accept with I'd love to! or say no politely with Sorry, I'm busy.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.7 Let's Do Something Together: A1 invites with Do you want to …? and Let's …; A1+ 7.7 invites politely. The one new grammar relationship is Would you like to + a verb (Would you like to come to my party?), which grows A1+ 5.3's Would you like + a thing (Would you like some tea?), answered with I'd love to! or Sorry, I'm busy. Three new photos tell the party story: Sofia invites at her door, Luis says yes with joy, Diego is buried in work; A1 7.7's sofa, park and table invitations come back.
prerequisite: A1 7.7 Do you want to … and the four activities; A1+ 5.3 Would you like + a thing; A1+ 5.9 I'd like; A1 4.11 come.
speaking_outcome: Join Would you like to (wud-yuh-LAIK-tuh); say I'd love to! with energy on LOVE. Do not require native-like speed.

title: 7.8 Could you repeat that, please?
unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
goal: Ask someone to repeat or to speak slowly (Could you repeat that, please?) and ask what a word means (What does hungry mean? It means you want to eat.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.8 Please Repeat: A1 repairs with I do not understand. Please repeat. Please speak slowly.; A1+ 7.8 asks politely and asks what a word means. The new grammar relationships are Could you + a verb + please? for a polite request (Could you repeat that, please? / Could you speak slowly, please?), building on A1+ 6.10's Could you tell me where …?, and What does + a word + mean? answered with It means … (What does hungry mean? It means you want to eat.). A1 7.8's photos of Ana puzzled at a ticket counter and on a street come back, and A1 7.2's hungry baby, thirsty man and tired grandfather and A1 7.4's cold woman show the words whose meaning is asked.
prerequisite: A1 7.8 I do not understand, please repeat, speak slowly, fast; A1 7.2 hungry, thirsty, tired; A1 7.4 cold; A1+ 1.8 don't; A1+ 6.10 Could you tell me …?.
speaking_outcome: Join Could you (KUD-juh) and let the voice go up at please?; stress MEAN in What does hungry mean?. Do not require native-like speed.

title: 7.15 El picnic de Sofía
unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
goal: Help at Sofia's birthday picnic: find the guests by what they wear, what they are doing, what hurts and what they do in the rain, find the tallest and shortest child, and answer Ana's friends aloud about the party, why she is happy, what she likes doing, the weather and her birthday month.

title: 1.14 Everyone to the Celebration!
unit_outcome: Understand and say short German sentences about people and what they are doing.
goal: Bring everyone to one family celebration by finding people, connecting the family, following actions, correcting false clues and answering who they are.
grammar_function: All German Unit 1 patterns, in a mission.
speaking_outcome: Answer who the family members are, out loud.

cards.audio_text: Ein Junge. Ein Mädchen. Ein Mann. Eine Frau.
cards.spanish_translation: A boy. A girl. A man. A woman.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 01/24: the learner follows one German clue and discovers how the game responds; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

audio_assets.text: The celebration is about to start and some guests are still missing. Listen to each German sentence, find the people, and discover what they are doing. At the end you will answer out loud to open the celebration. First we will practise together.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and tap the person.

cards.audio_text: Ein Mädchen. Ein Mann. Eine Frau. Ein Junge.
cards.spanish_translation: A girl. A man. A woman. A boy.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen to one sentence at a time and tap the person.

mission.title: The International Dinner
mission.briefing: Today is the community center's international dinner and Ana needs your help. Listen to each sentence and find who says it or who it describes: greetings, names, countries, ages, jobs and each guest's things. At the end, answer out loud at the table. First listen to the whole sentence, then tap the person.
mission.completion_message: You recognized greetings and introductions, met every guest, found out what they do and what they have, and answered out loud. The international dinner can begin.

grammar_function: All Spanish A1 patterns, in a mission.
speaking_outcome: Go to the park with Ana, then answer out loud.
